# The callback that arrives during lunch

Mum missed the clinic callback while helping a neighbour. The voicemail asks her to call the general number, which begins the queue again. The service measures answered calls but not repeated waiting time. We agreed a two-hour callback window would help more than another attempt at an unpredictable moment. Put the proposed wording in [[Care arrangements]] before the next review.
